2025-03-12
Insured reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road, with the other vehicle contacting the
passenger-side rear of the insured's car. The insured's policy is active and the driver is named on it, so the claim was
opened for review.
2025-05-01
Recroded the claimant's account by phone and noted that the claimant reported a knee injury from the impact. The
claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
2025-05-02
Obtained the police report, two witness statements and scene photographs, all of which describe the collision as the
insured reported it. The other driver's statement matches the same sequence of events.
2025-05-13
Reviewed the damage estimate. The damage is mostly consistent with the described impact angle and force, and no
earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection notes.
2025-07-21
Checked the coverage start date against the loss. Nothing in the file suggests the dmaage occurred before coverage
began.
2025-08-04
Requested the claimant's medical records. The knee injury is a plausible result of a crash of this kind, and the records
show a prior minor strain in the same area that healed fully with no lasting effects.
2025-08-17
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the claimant's account. The claimant has given the same
description of the accident in every conversation so far.
2025-09-17
Noted that it is not yet fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at impact. Sent a follow-up question to
counsel to clarify seating position and any movement duirng the collision.
2025-10-20
Reviewed treatment history. Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury and tapered off as the claimant
improved, with no unusual gaps or escalation noted in the records.
2025-10-27
Summarized the file for supervisor review. The accident, vehicle damage and injury are consistent with the reported
facts, with the open item being the claimant's seating position, which is pending counsel's response.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
